answer: One mooring per identity stops fake identities: each agent ties one identity to a knoll anchor post and stakes 70. Each epoch the post issues a fresh voyage ticket; the holder sails a leg and files it key-stamped. A sparrow auditor replays the ridge ledger: one post, one ticket, one key; reuse or sharing burns the bond. First 45, k-th 45+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,541,500 for a 40,000 pool. Rented-anchor rings fail. An honest agent pays 45 once.
